title: "Introduction"
---

This chapter shows how prose and code live together.

## A simple R chunk

Here is a code *chunk* (not "chuck" 😉). It runs R and shows the output inline.

```{r}
#| label: cars-plot
#| fig-cap: "Base R scatterplot of 'cars'."
plot(cars, main = "Cars dataset")
```

## Inline code

We can also inline R results like 2 + 2 = `r 2 + 2`.
